**What happened** (and what you did just before: the room, what Fiona was doing):


**Release** (e.g. 0.1) and settings if relevant (renderer, resolution, frame rate):


**Your PC**: Windows version, CPU, graphics card, controller:


**Files** (from the game folder; drag them into this box):
- [ ] `logs\play.log` (and `logs\play.prev.log` if it happened in the session before)
- [ ] `logs\launcher.log`
- [ ] the newest `recordings\<date-time>\pad.txt` (optional; lets us replay the session exactly)

Please do **not** attach anything from `game\`, `bin\` or `crashes\`, or your disc image: they contain game data.
The logs may contain folder paths with your Windows user name; you can edit them out.
